custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create four active parts for this test, part A, part B, part C and part D, whose part numbers run A to Z in that order.
    • How to do it: Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 PART A in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-A in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 PART B in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-B in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 PART C in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-C in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save. Click Parts in the top bar, Inventory in the left menu, then New Inventory Part. Type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 PART D in Description and ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-D in Part Number, pick any category under Category, type 10.00 in Cost and 20.00 in Sell Price, type 5 in the Quantity of the bin row, then click Save.
  • Create a canned job for this test, canned job A, holding, in this order, part C, part B, part A and part D, one of each.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 LINE C in Title and press Tab, pick any Labor Rate, tick Line Approved, then click Save & Close. Add p, a, r, t, s, , C, ,, , B, ,, , A, , a, n, d, , D, , (, i, n, , t, h, a, t, , o, r, d, e, r, ) to that line, one of each: in the line's Parts row click + Add Part, type the part number in Part number, pick the result that shows Inventory Qty, type 1 in Qty *, then click Save. Then click the three-dot icon on the line, click Save as canned line, type ZZAUTOTEST PL C573684 CANNED JOB A in Line Title and click Save As Canned Line.
  • Set parts A, B and C inactive after canned job A is saved.
    • How to do it: On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-A, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-B, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window. On the Inventory page click Search, type ZZAUTOTEST-PL-C573684-C, click its row, click Inactive under Part Status, click Save, then click Deactivate in the Deactivate part? window.
  • Create an open work order, work order 1, for this test, with no lines.
    • How to do it: Click Work Orders in the top bar, then Create Work Order; pick any Customer and any Asset, then click Save. The New Line window opens by itself: close it with the X at its top right, so the work order has no lines.
  • Start on work order 1, on its Lines tab.
